name: Bar Pasha 2312
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Bar Pasha 2312 in Telfs – your ultimate escape in the heart of Tirol!** Step into a world where **Tirol’s** rugged charm meets futuristic vibes. At **Bar Pasha 2312**, we blend the best of alpine adventure with cutting-edge style—because why should relaxation be boring? 🔥 **By Day:** Sip on craft cocktails with a view of the **Innsbruck** skyline, or enjoy a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with a twist. Our terrace is the perfect spot to soak up the sun while the **Inn** flows by. 🌃 **By Night:** The real magic happens after dark. Our DJs spin everything from deep house to retro beats, turning the bar into **Telfs’** hottest nightlife hub. Dance until dawn or unwind with a **Apfelstrudel** and a cold **Radler**—your call. 🚀 **Why Us?** ✔ **Location:** Right in **Telfs**, where the **Inn** meets the mountains—adventure is always close. ✔ **Vibes:** A mix of **Tirol’s** cozy warmth and high-energy fun. ✔ **Food & Drinks:** From **Tiroler Gröstl** to inventive cocktails, we’ve got your cravings covered. Whether you're here for the **Nordkette**, a **Hüttenabend**, or just a night out, **Bar Pasha 2312** is your go-to spot. **Prost!** 🍻 --- **Visit us | Follow on Instagram**
